+def _get_fill_value(dtype):
+    """Get the appropriate fill value for a given dtype."""
+    import numpy as np
+    if dtype.kind == 'f':  # floating point
+        return np.nan
+    elif dtype.kind == 'c':  # complex
+        return np.nan + np.nan * 1j
+    else:
+        # For integer and other types, use 0
+        return 0
+
+
+def _create_nan_filled_variable(var, dim, concat_dim_length, fill_value=dtypes.NA):
+    """Create a NaN-filled variable with the same shape as var, but with concat_dim_length along dim."""
+    import numpy as np
+    
+    # Determine the fill value
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        fill_value = _get_fill_value(var.dtype)
+    
+    # Create the new shape
+    new_shape = list(var.shape)
+    if dim in var.dims:
+        dim_idx = var.dims.index(dim)
+        new_shape[dim_idx] = concat_dim_length
+    else:
+        # If dim is not in var.dims, we need to add it
+        new_shape = (concat_dim_length,) + tuple(new_shape)
+        new_dims = (dim,) + var.dims
+    
+    # Create the NaN-filled array
+    new_data = np.full(new_shape, fill_value, dtype=var.dtype)
+    
+    # Create the new variable
+    if dim in var.dims:
+        new_var = Variable(var.dims, new_data, attrs=var.attrs, encoding=var.encoding)
+    else:
+        new_var = Variable(new_dims, new_data, attrs=var.attrs, encoding=var.encoding)
+    
+    return new_var
+
